Chapter 3: Salt and Signal
The Lighthouse Ledger by quill_and_tide
2.1k 3 17
PreviousNext

The fog came in sideways that night, which Wren had been told was impossible.

“Impossible,” she repeated to the logbook, and the logbook, in a hand that was not hers, had already written sideways fog, 02:10 under tomorrow's date.

She checked the lamp. She checked it again. The beam went out over the water and came back wrong, bent a degree to the south, as if the sea had leaned.

There was a note pinned inside the cupboard door, older than the paint: read the first entry again.
